## Purpose
User entity.

## Rationale
This target does not exist: [[auth.user.ghost|a phrase a human reads]]. The
finding must name the target half, because that is the text an author has to
change — reporting the alias sends them looking for a file nobody wrote.

None beyond Fields constraints.
